IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
Disconnected Start Live -> Settings retains a one-shot continuation intent.
Only an explicit connection attempt accepts it. Once camera connection and
photo inventory are ready, the app returns to Photo Live and opens New Project.
The user still names/confirms a project before reception starts. Failure can
retry without consuming the intent. Cancel/leaving clears it; ordinary Settings
connection does not open a project. Preset-import and live setup intents exclude
each other. Revision tokens reject old queued callbacks after cancel/replacement.
The state object holds neither Runnable nor Activity and has no Android dependency.
